# Cross-references from two sources, merged. Leads only, never evidence. Columns: reference | source | heading | linked references. Sources: 'Treasury' = Treasury of Scripture Knowledge (public domain); the heading is a word or phrase from the King James wording of the verse. 'Berean section' = the Berean Standard Bible's cross-references for the section the verse sits in; the heading is the section title and its range. 'Berean note (quotes)' = a Berean footnote naming the verse this one quotes; 'Berean note (quoted in)' = a Berean footnote naming a later verse that quotes this one; for both, the heading is the Berean English the footnote is attached to.
